achievements.name: Matchstick
achievements.detail: Strike a foe with Glimmer's matchstick while its flame lights the way.

achievements.name: Slingshot
achievements.detail: Shoot the matchstick into a wall and bounce off the planted stick.

achievements.name: Wall Climb
achievements.detail: Scale a sheer wall with the climb before stamina gives out.

achievements.name: Tent Save
achievements.detail: Rest inside a tent to heal and save your progress.

achievements.name: Trinket
achievements.detail: Equip a trinket so its perk changes how Glimmer plays.

achievements.name: Spectral Bird
achievements.detail: Find a spectral bird and bring it back home.

achievements.name: Time Trial
achievements.detail: Finish a timed platforming trial hidden on the map.

achievements.name: Combat Trial
achievements.detail: Clear a combat challenge room packed with a wave of foes.

achievements.name: Story Page
achievements.detail: Pick up a storybook page that adds to the kingdom's tales.

achievements.name: Golden Feathers
achievements.detail: Collect all seven golden feathers the journey asks you to find.

achievements.name: Sibling Found
achievements.detail: Reunite with one of the siblings taken by the hunter.

achievements.name: Journey's End
achievements.detail: Reach the queen's quarters and finish the journey to save Glimmer's family.
